articles.summary: Former Apple global infrastructure leader, technology founder behind Cineverse's Matchpoint® platform, and AI infrastructure entrepreneur nominated to join the Board as Cineverse advances its next phase of technology and platform innovation. Corp. (Nasdaq: CNVS) ("Cineverse" or the "Company"), an entertainment technology company and studio, announced the nomination for election to its Board of Directors of Dr. Samrat Ganguly at Cineverse's upcoming annual meeting of stockholders on December 8, 2026. Dr. Ganguly spent more than a decade at Apple, most recently as head of the Company's global network infrastructure organization, where he was responsible for the architecture, engineering and operations of the network and security infrastructure behind iCloud, Apple TV, the App Store and the broader Apple services ecosystem. articles.title: Cineverse Nominates Dr. Samrat Ganguly for Election to Board of Directors
